snippet.title: Crownwarden | Official Trailer | Summer Game Fest 2026
snippet.description:
Crownwarden
Build by day, defend by night! In this story-driven city builder, take direct control of your ruler to protect the realm. Explore diverse lands, upgrade your leader's abilities, command armies against monstrous hordes, and uncover the dark secrets of your lineage.
